import json, os, subprocess, sys
bad = []

def serial_guard():
    ancestors, pid = set(), os.getpid()
    while pid > 1:
        ancestors.add(pid)
        try:
            pid = int(open("/proc/%d/stat" % pid).read().rsplit(")", 1)[1].split()[1])
        except (OSError, ValueError, IndexError):
            break
    for name in filter(str.isdigit, os.listdir("/proc")):
        if int(name) in ancestors:
            continue
        try:
            argv = [part.decode() for part in open("/proc/%s/cmdline" % name, "rb").read().split(b"\0") if part]
            cwd = os.readlink("/proc/%s/cwd" % name)
        except OSError:
            continue
        if cwd == os.getcwd() and len(argv) > 1 and os.path.basename(argv[0]) in ("bash", "sh") and argv[1].endswith(("tools/fixtures_self_test.sh", "tools/validate.sh")):
            print("REFUSED (exit 4): process %s is already running %s in this tree" % (name, argv[1]))
            sys.exit(4)

serial_guard()
pins = json.load(open(".agent/contracts/108.json"))["design_notes"]["pinned_interface"]

AT1 = ("import re,subprocess; "
       "h=subprocess.run(['bash','tools/validate.sh','--help'],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout; "
       "ids=set(re.findall(r'^\\[(C\\d+)\\]',subprocess.run(['bash','tools/validate.sh'],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout,re.M)); "
       "miss=[i for i in sorted(ids) if not re.search(r'^  '+i+r'\\s+\\S',h,re.M)]; "
       "assert ids and not miss, miss")
AT2 = ("import re,subprocess; "
       "h=subprocess.run(['bash','tools/validate.sh','--help'],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout; "
       "c5=h.split('  C5 ')[1].split('  C6 ')[0]; "
       "body=open('tools/validate.sh').read().split('check_c5_branding() {')[1].split('\\n}\\n')[0]; "
       "g=re.search(r'grep -(\\w+) ',body).group(1); ci='i' in g; "
       "assert ('case-insensitive' in c5)==ci and ('case-sensitive' in c5)!=ci, (g,c5[:160])")
AT4 = ("import re; t=open('tools/interface.md').read(); "
       "n=re.search(r'^(\\d+)\\. \\*\\*Failure behavior\\.\\*\\*',t.split('## 2. Discovery')[1].split('## 3.')[0],re.M).group(1); "
       "i10=' '.join(re.search(r'^10\\. (.*?)(?:\\n\\n|\\n## )',t.split('## 5.')[1],re.S|re.M).group(1).split()); "
       "assert '(Section 2, Item '+n+')' in i10, (n,i10)")
corrupt_c15 = ("p = root / 'tools/validate.sh'\n"
               "t = p.read_text()\n"
               "para = t.split('  C15 ')[1].split('\\n\\n')[0]\n"
               "assert para.count('vlib_profiles_map_roles') == 1\n"
               "t = t.replace('  C15 ' + para, '  C15 ' + para.replace('vlib_profiles_map_roles', 'vlib_profiles_map_rolez'), 1)\n"
               "p.write_text(t)\n")
drop_paras = ("p = root / 'tools/validate.sh'\n"
              "t = p.read_text()\n"
              "pins = " + repr(pins["insert_anchor_old"]) + "\n"
              "assert t.count(" + repr(pins["insert_anchor_new"]) + ") == 1\n"
              "p.write_text(t.replace(" + repr(pins["insert_anchor_new"]) + ", pins, 1))\n")
revert_c5 = ("p = root / 'tools/validate.sh'\n"
             "t = p.read_text()\n"
             "assert t.count(" + repr(pins["c5_help_new"]) + ") == 1\n"
             "p.write_text(t.replace(" + repr(pins["c5_help_new"]) + ", " + repr(pins["c5_help_old"]) + ", 1))\n")
revert_i10 = None
SR = [sys.executable, ".agent/evidence/phase-014-activation/gates/scratch_run.py"]

def one(name, args, expect_rc, expects, forbids, command):
    argv = SR + args + ["--expect-rc", str(expect_rc)]
    for pattern in expects:
        argv += ["--expect", pattern]
    for pattern in forbids:
        argv += ["--forbid", pattern]
    argv += ["--"] + command
    proc = subprocess.run(argv, capture_output=True, text=True)
    print(("PASS " if proc.returncode == 0 else "FAIL ") + name)
    if proc.returncode != 0:
        print("\n".join("    " + line for line in (proc.stdout + proc.stderr).splitlines()[-25:]))
        bad.append(name)

# Case 1: AT1 is existence-only. One corrupted word in the C15 paragraph
# leaves the C-id coverage intact (AT1 still exits 0) while the pinned full
# paragraph content is gone; only the S04 content pin catches it.
driver = ("import subprocess,sys; "
          "rc = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-c', " + repr(AT1) + "]).returncode; "
          "assert rc == 0, ('AT1 coverage broke', rc); "
          "h = subprocess.run(['bash','tools/validate.sh','--help'],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout; "
          "c15 = h.split('  C15 ')[1].split('\\n\\n')[0]; "
          "assert " + repr(pins["c15_content_needle"]) + " not in c15, 'corruption not applied'; "
          "print('AT1 COVERAGE INTACT; PINNED CONTENT GONE')")
one("one corrupted word in C15: AT1 still passes (existence-only); the pinned content is gone",
    ["--py-mutate", corrupt_c15], 0, [r"^AT1 COVERAGE INTACT; PINNED CONTENT GONE$"],
    [], [sys.executable, "-c", driver])

# Case 2: reverting only the C5 paragraph text to the old case-insensitive
# wording leaves the sweep green (16/16, [C5] PASS) but AT2 fails -- AT2 is
# the text-vs-code drift detector; the sweep alone cannot see it.
driver2 = ("import subprocess,sys,re; "
           "proc = subprocess.run(['bash','tools/validate.sh'],capture_output=True,text=True); "
           "assert proc.returncode == 0, proc.stdout[-400:]; "
           "assert 'SUMMARY: 16 passed, 0 failed' in proc.stdout; "
           "assert re.search(r'^\\[C5\\] PASS branding-leakage$', proc.stdout, re.M), proc.stdout[-400:]; "
           "rc = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-c', " + repr(AT2) + "]).returncode; "
           "assert rc != 0, 'AT2 unexpectedly passed on reverted text'; "
           "print('SWEEP GREEN 16/16 WITH [C5] PASS; AT2 FAILED')")
one("C5 paragraph reverted to 'case-insensitive' text: sweep still 16/16 with [C5] PASS, AT2 fails",
    ["--py-mutate", revert_c5], 0, [r"^SWEEP GREEN 16/16 WITH \[C5\] PASS; AT2 FAILED$"],
    [], [sys.executable, "-c", driver2])

# Case 3: restoring the Item 4 citation in interface.md fails AT4 while the
# rest of the tree is untouched.
one("interface.md item 10 citation restored to Item 4: AT4 fails",
    ["--replace", "tools/interface.md", pins["iface_item10_new"], pins["iface_item10_old"]],
    "nonzero", [r"AssertionError"], [], [sys.executable, "-c", AT4])

# Case 4: dropping all three new paragraphs removes AT1's coverage -- the
# paragraphs are load-bearing; an empty help region cannot pass.
one("all three new paragraphs dropped: AT1 fails (no C14/C15/C16 headers)",
    ["--py-mutate", drop_paras], "nonzero", [r"AssertionError"], [],
    [sys.executable, "-c", AT1])

# Case 5: green guards on the pinned tree in scratch -- default sweep 16/16
# and --payload sweep 12/12, one process at a time.
one("pinned tree: default sweep 16/16 and payload sweep 12/12",
    [], 0, [r"^SUMMARY: 16 passed, 0 failed$", r"^SUMMARY \(payload mode\): 12 passed, 0 failed$"],
    [r"^\[C\d+\] FAIL"], ["bash", "-c", "bash tools/validate.sh && bash tools/validate.sh --payload"])

print("cases: 5 problems:", bad)
sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)
PY
